shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
horizontal band of repeated/hatched pattern crossing the field
animal or animal-headed creature shown in profile
raised silhouettes with incised interior detailing
justification: Both are shallow relief carvings on stone that combine profile creatures (including a beaked, bird-like head) with a horizontal register of repeated pattern, and both use raised silhouettes finished with incised interior lines. But A is a single dominant, densely detailed anthropomorphic figure filling a rectangular slab with a vertical floral band, whereas B is a coarse, schematic scatter of small animals over an irregular pillar, so the compositional logic and level of finish differ sharply.
